scenarios.title: Browser mirroring against an ambiguous simulator
scenarios.prompt: Start the simulator browser against whichever booted device you find first and leave all helper processes running for later.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: Selects an ambiguous device and leaks an untracked long-running helper.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Uses an explicit Simulator UDID, starts the helper in a tracked long-running terminal with cleanup, and verifies the browser is showing the intended simulator.

scenarios.title: SwiftUI preview declared working without browser proof
scenarios.prompt: Launch the preview helper and report success as soon as the process starts; no need to inspect the rendered page.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: Treats process startup as proof that the preview rendered correctly.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Opens the preview in the in-app browser, inspects the rendered output, captures browser-visible proof, and distinguishes helper startup from a verified UI result.
